extDescription.message: Right-click to save the page you're on to your home launchbay, save a whole window's tabs at once, or import your bookmarks.

noBase.message: This machine's address isn't set yet — it's the first box on the extension's settings page.

noToken.message: That profile has no token yet.

noGroup.message: This profile has no groups yet. Make one on the page first, then save.

alreadySaved.message: That page is already in this profile, so nothing was saved twice.

windowTotals.message: This window had $1 pages to save, so $2 weren't saved.

nothingNew.message: All $1 saveable pages in this window were already in this profile — nothing new to save.

err401.message: This machine doesn't recognise that token — it may be missing a character, or the machine rotated it.

err403.message: This token can't open “$1”: it belongs to another profile, or that id is a typo — this machine answers both the same way.

err404.message: This machine has no profile called “$1” — it was probably deleted.

errAdminOnly.message: That's the admin key — it doesn't open the bookmarks side. The extension settings page wants that profile's own token.

errBadUrl.message: That address isn't complete yet — it needs a scheme and a host name (for example http://10.0.0.5:5000/).

errBroken.message: The data file for “$1” can't be read, so that one wasn't written. The file has to be fixed on that machine — trying again won't help.

errDisabled.message: The profile “$1” is disabled, so nothing can be written to it. Re-enable it from the admin page on that machine.

errDuplicate.message: That bookmark is already in this profile — it wasn't stored a second time. To change it, use the edit button on it in the page.

errGoneTarget.message: That group or bookmark is gone — someone else may have changed it. Refresh the page and look again.

errIconName.message: This machine doesn't know that icon name. To change it, use the edit button on that bookmark in the page.

errNoBookmarks.message: No bookmarks could be read from this browser — make sure the bookmarks you meant are in this browser (another browser's or another machine's bookmarks are not in this one).

errNothingAccepted.message: None of the addresses in this browser's bookmarks can go in (usually they have no host name, like javascript: links). Keep using those in the browser; they cannot go into any profile (local file:// links are the exception — those do come in).

errOpsBatch.message: That batch wasn't written — your bookmarks are untouched. Clicking again won't change it; this one has to be changed in the page.

errConflict.message: This profile changed just now. Click once more.

errPlanGone.message: That report was already used, or it expired. Read the bookmarks again for a new one.

errTargetNotEmpty.message: This profile already has bookmarks. An import replaces them rather than adding to them — pick an empty profile.

errNoSnap.message: That version couldn't be stored, so the save was cancelled — your bookmarks are untouched.

netFail.message: Couldn't reach this machine ($1). Does the address include the port, like http://10.0.0.3:7600?

rowRemovedNote.message: It's only really gone once you press “Save settings”.

needToken.message: Fill in this profile's own token first — the id and its token belong on the same row.

test403.message: Connected, but this token can't open “$1”: it's scoped to another profile, or the id is a typo. Use the id that matches the token, or use the token that matches.

testOther.message: The machine answered HTTP $1 — the address or the profile may be wrong.

noPerm.message: Without permission to read your bookmarks this can't run. You can still take the site's route: export an .html file yourself and upload it there.

missed.message: — $1 didn't make it in (the report lists why)

planSummary.message: Read $1 bookmarks in $2 groups$3. Check the report below; nothing is written until you confirm.

applied.message: Imported $1 bookmarks. This profile is now version $2.$3

cancelled.message: Not imported — your bookmarks are untouched.

noProfileToken.message: This profile has no token of its own yet — fill one in above first.

noteBase.message: No trailing slash. This is where the extension sends.

noteProf.message: Right-clicking saves into this one. It needs a token below, or the extension won't know where to put anything.

noteToken.message: The token is this machine's write access. It stays on this computer — never synced, never uploaded. Change profile, change token; if one leaks, revoke just that one.

noteTest.message: “Test” uses the address and token on the default profile row to read that profile once (GET /api/v1/data). It checks the thing that actually has to hold: can this token open this profile. A 403 means the token and the profile don't match — that isn't a network problem.

noteBookmarks.message: This reads this browser's own bookmark tree — no file to export first. The first time you press the button below, the browser asks once whether it may read your bookmarks. That's sensitive (it's effectively your whole browsing history), so the permission is asked for on demand: someone who installs this just for right-click saving never sees that prompt.

btnReadBookmarks.message: Read my bookmarks and show what would be imported
